LESSON: PLEDGES OF AQABAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.2: Pledges of Aqabah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Pledges of Aqabah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Pledges of Aqabah
2. Practise Pledges of Aqabah at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pledges of Aqabah

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Pledges of Aqabah
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Pledges of Aqabah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Pledges of Aqabah at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Pledges of Aqabah at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pledges of Aqabah
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Pledges of Aqabah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Pledges of Aqabah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Pledges of Aqabah in the examples.
2. Explain Pledges of Aqabah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pledges of Aqabah.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pledges of Aqabah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Pledges of Aqabah important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Pledges of Aqabah
2. Practise Pledges of Aqabah at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Pledges of Aqabah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
